title.zh: Bitcoin SPV Type Lock 约束（主网 btc-mainnet-v0.1.0）
title.en: Bitcoin SPV Type Lock Constraints (mainnet btc-mainnet-v0.1.0)

subtitle.en: Source: ckb-cell/ckb-bitcoin-spv-contracts @f3e3ba8 (tag btc-mainnet-v0.1.0) contracts/ckb-bitcoin-spv-type-lock + ckb-bitcoin-spv verifier @a3c43fd　·　mainnet 0xa76e…741d (type)

outputs.label: Info cell
outputs.body: Cell{ type: { codeHash: {{SPV_TYPE_LOCK}}, args: SpvTypeArgs }, data: SpvInfo { tip_client_id: {{0}} } }

outputs.label: Client cell × n
outputs.body:
Cell{ type: same type,
  data: SpvClient { id: {{0..n-1}}, tip_block_hash, headers_mmr_root, target_adjust_info } }

role.zh: 0x80 = 跳过难度 / PoW 检查
最新 BTC 区块哈希（内部字节序）
role.en: latest BTC block hash (internal byte order)

cons.zh: = 最后一个 header 的 sha256d

layout.name: headers_mmr_root
layout.role: HeaderDigest { min_height, max_height, partial_chain_work U256 LE, children_hash }

cond.zh: 本实例输出 ≥ 4、连续排列、数量 = 1 + clients_count
blake2b(第一个 CellInput ‖ 输出数量 u64)
都等于由 bootstrap 计算的 client，id 依次递增
cond.en: all equal the client derived from the bootstrap, ids increasing

extras.zh: cell_deps 中放当前 tip client（id = t）；新 client 是在它上面接上 headers 的结果。
extras.en: The current tip client (id = t) goes in cell_deps; the new client is that client extended by the headers.

cond.zh: 各是一个 SpvInfo + 一个 SpvClient；输入 client id = next(t)；输出 info = next(t)
cond.en: one SpvInfo + one SpvClient each; input client id = next(t); output info = next(t)

cond.zh: 恰一个本实例 client，id = t
cond.en: exactly one client of this instance, id = t

cond.zh: 非空；与 tip 连续；bits = 期望难度；PoW；MMR 证明；新 client 的 id、tip、高度、target_adjust_info 正确
cond.en: non-empty; continue the tip; bits = expected difficulty; PoW; MMR proof; new client id, tip, heights, target_adjust_info correct

cond.zh: 一个 info + ≥ 2 个 client，id 是从 tip 往回连续的一段
cond.en: one info + ≥ 2 clients whose ids are a consecutive run back from tip

cond.zh: 同一组 id；所有 client 相同；info 指向最旧的那个
cond.en: same id set; all clients identical; info points at the oldest

cond.zh: cell_dep 为分叉点 client；headers 同更新规则
cond.en: cell_dep is the fork-point client; headers follow the update rules

notes.zh: 版本：链上主网 code cell（0x1dc9a535…:0，type id 可升级，至今未升级）数据的 sha256 = 481b173c…，等于 tag btc-mainnet-v0.1.0（= origin/production = f3e3ba8）checksums.txt 中的 ckb-bitcoin-spv-type-lock。
notes.en: Version: the sha256 of the on-chain mainnet code cell data (0x1dc9a535…:0, type-id upgradable, never upgraded so far) is 481b173c…, equal to the ckb-bitcoin-spv-type-lock line in checksums.txt at tag btc-mainnet-v0.1.0 (= origin/production = f3e3ba8).

notes.zh: code hash 来源：RGB++ lock 配置 cell（0x04c5c3e6…:1）中的 btc_lc_type_hash = 0x00a2…c6f7，对应 cell_dep 0xd6b2fcb7…:1 的 type，其 code_hash 即本合约。
notes.en: Code hash source: btc_lc_type_hash in the RGB++ lock config cell (0x04c5c3e6…:1) is 0x00a2…c6f7, the type of cell_dep 0xd6b2fcb7…:1, whose code_hash is this script.

notes.zh: 测试网未收录：BTC testnet3 实例 0xc8a3…6d28 当前二进制 sha256 043f7318… 不在任何 tag 的 checksums.txt 中；signet 实例 0x73d9…e25e = tag v0.2.0（启用了销毁且 flags 含义改变），与本页规则不同。
notes.en: Testnet not included: the BTC testnet3 instance 0xc8a3…6d28 currently runs a binary (sha256 043f7318…) not listed in any tag's checksums.txt; the signet instance 0x73d9…e25e is tag v0.2.0 (destroy enabled, flags redefined), whose rules differ from this page.

notes.zh: 此版本 entry.rs 注释掉了销毁分支，所以 (n, 0) 走 UnknownOperation 0x10。
notes.en: This version comments out the destroy branch in entry.rs, so (n, 0) falls to UnknownOperation 0x10.

notes.zh: 解码器会计算每个 header 的 sha256d、检查内部连续性、PoW 与新 tip；与 cell_dep 中 tip client 相关的部分（接续、期望难度、MMR、高度、target_adjust_info）无法检查。
notes.en: The decoder computes each header sha256d and checks internal continuity, PoW and the new tip; everything tied to the tip client in cell_deps (continuation, expected difficulty, MMR, heights, target_adjust_info) cannot be checked.

notes.zh: 错误码（error.rs）：0x01–0x05 syscall · 0x10 UnknownOperation · 0x20–0x28 创建 · 0x2f DestroyNotEnoughCells · 0x30–0x3a 更新 · 0x40–0x51 重组 · 0x60 + BootstrapError / UpdateError（0x69 EmptyHeaders · 0x6a UncontinuousHeaders · 0x6b Difficulty · 0x6c Pow · 0x71 Mmr · 0x72 HeadersMmrProof · 0x79 ClientId · 0x7a ClientTipBlockHash · 0x7b/0x7c 高度 · 0x7d ClientTargetAdjustInfo）
notes.en: Error codes (error.rs): 0x01–0x05 syscall · 0x10 UnknownOperation · 0x20–0x28 create · 0x2f DestroyNotEnoughCells · 0x30–0x3a update · 0x40–0x51 reorg · 0x60 + BootstrapError / UpdateError (0x69 EmptyHeaders · 0x6a UncontinuousHeaders · 0x6b Difficulty · 0x6c Pow · 0x71 Mmr · 0x72 HeadersMmrProof · 0x79 ClientId · 0x7a ClientTipBlockHash · 0x7b/0x7c heights · 0x7d ClientTargetAdjustInfo)
